data.title:
KRITANO.
*270 checks, one audit.*
data.body: Checks across SEO, accessibility, security, performance, content and structured data. Where a problem is on the page, the finding points to the exact element.

data.title:
CG-CMS.
*Pages served in 0.4 ms.*
data.body: The CMS this site runs on: an Inertia and React admin, content in Postgres, and every page written to disk when it's saved.
data.caption: Fig. 02 · the cg-cms admin

image.alt: The cg-cms admin dashboard at chrisgarlick.com: alerts, published and draft counts, leads this week, page cache warmth and recent articles

data.title:
THIS SITE.
*Every URL kept.*
data.body: Moved from Astro and a Bun CMS to Laravel and cg-cms, with all 79 live URLs kept, lab LCP down from about 3 seconds to under 2, and more than 500 automated tests.
data.caption: Fig. 03 · chrisgarlick.com before the rebuild, October 2026

data.title:
TYPESET.
*Print-quality PDFs from plain text.*
data.body: My Rust service that turns Markdown into branded PDFs: the proposals, scopes and audit reports I send. It's private, behind an IP allowlist.
